value.title: JUJUTSU KAISEN: Execution
value.synopsis: A veil abruptly descends over the busy Shibuya area trapping countless civilians inside. Satoru Gojo, the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, Yuji Itadori, his classmates, and other top-tier jujutsu sorcerers, enter the fray in an unprecedented clash of curses — the Shibuya Incident. In the aftermath, the deadly Culling Game starts, and Special Grade sorcerer Yuta Okkotsu is assigned to carry out Yuji’s execution for his perceived crimes.
